newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Morocco condemns girl's death in Belgium as crime. [CORRECTED 08:50 GMT 9/3]
newsitem.headline: Morocco condemns girl's death in Belgium as crime. [CORRECTED 08:50 GMT 9/3]

text.p: The body of a Moroccan-born girl found in a trunk under a Brussels garage near her family's home will be flown to Morocco on Saturday evening for burial, and the government there called her death a "savage and inhuman act".
"The government of His Majesty the King (Hassan II) condemns the odious crime and denounces this savage and inhuman act," a statement carried by the official MAP news agency said.
The Belgian consulate said Loubna Benaissa would be buried on Sunday in a cemetery in the northern city of Tangiers after a Moslem prayer at Mohammed V Mosque at about 12:45 p.m (1245 GMT).
Belgian ambassador Marc Van Rysseleerghe was expected to be present when her body arrived in Tangiers and would attend the funeral, his embassy in Rabat said.
Loubna disappeared aged nine in August 1992. She is the fifth girl (Corrects from "third child") to have been found dead within six months in Belgium, already in shock from a paedophile scandal.
